rule: Two stages (Nov 15). Real money starts as a trial: 20+ counted copies in 15+ events at score 77.5+ (4 trial slots; a paper 80+ is still a trial). Full tier comes ONLY from real results (15+ real copies in 10+ events, profitable). Once on real money only real P&L decides: back to paper when real losses use up its budget ($1 at 77.5 up to $5 at 80+, set once by its paper score at admission; plus real profit banked). Paper is only the admissions test. A trial with no real copy for 48 h gives up its slot to the next in line (24 h wait to return). Paper grade: judged once it has 50+ counted (buyable, settled) copies in 30+ different events. Score = 80 + 2.5 x expected profit per copy (c/contract after fees): every trader starts at what copying earns on average (-2.6c now) and only its own counted copies move it, one credit per event, our real-money results counting double. Copied at 80+ (expected profit above 0) while its last 50 copies average better than -leeway (5c, +up to 5c for a high score); paused below that, back when it recovers. Size: 90+ = 2, 95+ (300 copies) = 3, only after 20+ real copies in profit

boss.summary: Judged 20 near-bar traders for Copycat. Most show negative expected value and poor copy-pay gaps, with the average trader losing about 2.4c per contract. Several are heavy market makers (reddington, large.ermine, tommystorms) and should be filtered. Keeping only PrettyFlacko42 on real money is defensible given its strong last-50 average, but its follow_5m and expected edge are weak; others are marginal and mostly skipped or left on less leeway.
